bank.q: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
bank.why: Fakta umum memakai present simple; subjek tunggal: boils.

bank.q: I ___ a student, and my friends are students too.
bank.why: Subjek I memakai am.

bank.q: My father is ___ engineer.
bank.why: Engineer diawali bunyi vokal, jadi an.

bank.q: I have two ___ in my bag.
bank.why: Kata berakhiran -x ditambah -es: boxes.

bank.q: We have a math test ___ Monday.
bank.why: Untuk hari dipakai on.

bank.q: My mother's sister is my ___.
bank.why: Saudara perempuan ibu adalah aunt (bibi).

bank.q: A fish ___ swim, but it cannot walk.
bank.why: Setelah can dipakai verb dasar, tanpa s.

bank.q: She ___ her homework before dinner yesterday.
bank.why: Yesterday menandakan masa lalu; lampau dari do adalah did.

bank.q: Mix blue and yellow, and you get ___.
bank.why: Biru dicampur kuning menjadi hijau (green).

bank.q: "Is he your brother?" "Yes, he ___."
bank.why: Jawaban singkat mengulang verb be: Yes, he is.

bank.q: We ___ in Bandung for five years, and we still live there.
bank.why: Masih berlanjut sampai sekarang: present perfect (have lived).

bank.q: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
bank.why: May I ...? dipakai untuk meminta izin dengan sopan.

bank.q: English ___ in many countries.
bank.why: Bahasa itu dituturkan (pasif): is + past participle.

bank.q: Wait here until the teacher ___ you.
bank.why: Setelah until untuk masa depan dipakai present simple: calls.

bank.q: She enjoys ___ novels in her free time.
bank.why: Setelah enjoy memakai gerund: reading.

bank.q: If I ___ rich, I would buy a big house.
bank.why: Second conditional: If + past simple (were), would + verb.

bank.q: He is married ___ a teacher.
bank.why: Kolokasi tetap: married to.

bank.q: This exercise is not as difficult ___ the last one.
bank.why: Pola tetap: not as + adjective + as.

bank.q: My boss gave me a ___ on my performance. It was very helpful.
bank.why: Feedback = masukan, dipakai sebagai kata tak terhitung.

bank.q: The meeting was ___ off because the manager was sick.
bank.why: Call off = membatalkan.

bank.q: If we had left earlier, we ___ the flight.
bank.why: Third conditional: would have + past participle untuk penyesalan masa lalu.

bank.q: The documents ___ by the time the manager arrived.
bank.why: Pasif past perfect: had been + past participle.

bank.q: Only after the test ___ about the mistake.
bank.why: Only after di awal kalimat memicu inversi: did she realize.

bank.q: She stayed calm ___ the pressure.
bank.why: Despite + kata benda (the pressure) = meskipun.

bank.q: I wish I ___ the answer yesterday.
bank.why: Penyesalan tentang masa lalu: wish + past perfect.

bank.q: The government plans to ___ new taxes next year.
bank.why: Kolokasi umum: introduce new taxes.

bank.q: How long ___ for the bus?
bank.why: Durasi yang masih berlanjut: present perfect continuous.

bank.q: Please ___ the attached document and reply by Monday.
bank.why: Review = memeriksa. Revive = menghidupkan kembali.

bank.q: "I will call you tomorrow," he said. -> He said he ___ me the next day.
bank.why: Dalam reported speech will menjadi would dan tomorrow menjadi the next day.

bank.q: When the team won, the manager was over the ___.
bank.why: Idiom over the moon = sangat senang.

bank.q: The committee demands that every member ___ the rules.
bank.why: Setelah demand that dipakai verb dasar (subjunctive).

bank.q: She had her hair ___ yesterday.
bank.why: Causative: have + objek + past participle (had her hair cut).

bank.q: What surprised me ___ his calm reaction.
bank.why: Pseudo-cleft: What + klausa + was + ... (tunggal, masa lalu).

bank.q: He works ___ a translator at a large firm.
bank.why: As menyatakan peran/pekerjaan. Like berarti seperti.

bank.q: Her explanation was ___; everyone understood it at once.
bank.why: Lucid = jelas. Obscure dan vague = tidak jelas.

bank.q: He ___ be at work now. I saw his car outside the house.
bank.why: Karena mobilnya terlihat di rumah, dugaan kuat bahwa ia tidak di kantor: can't.

bank.q: ___ of the two answers is correct. Both are wrong.
bank.why: Neither = tidak satu pun dari dua. Cocok dengan kalimat kedua.

bank.q: No sooner had she arrived ___ it started to rain.
bank.why: Pola tetap: No sooner had ... than ...

bank.q: The scandal ___ serious doubts about the company's honesty.
bank.why: Kolokasi: raise doubts = menimbulkan keraguan.

bank.q: We regret to ___ you that your application was unsuccessful.
bank.why: Regret to inform = formal. Tell dan say kurang cocok untuk surat resmi.

bank.q: You may use my laptop ___ you save your files elsewhere.
bank.why: As long as = asalkan, sama dengan provided.

bank.q: The room was ___ small for all of us.
bank.why: Too + adjective + for = terlalu ... untuk ...

articles.title: A Phone Call to Grandma
body: Every Sunday, Sari calls her grandmother. Grandma lives in a small village, far from the city. She does not have a smartphone, so they talk on the old house phone.
Last Sunday, Grandma said that she had a new hobby. She now grows flowers in front of her house. She has red, white and yellow roses.
Sari was very happy to hear that. She promised to visit her in the school holiday and help her in the garden.

qs.q: When does Sari call her grandmother?

articles.title: The Rise of Online Shopping
body: Over the past decade, online shopping has changed the way people buy almost everything. With a few taps on a phone, customers can compare prices, read reviews and have goods delivered to their door.
For small businesses, this has opened new opportunities. A seller in a small town can now reach customers all over the country without renting an expensive shop.

However, there are drawbacks. Some buyers receive items that look different from the photos, and returning them can be difficult. Experts advise reading reviews carefully and choosing sellers with a clear refund policy.

qs.q: How has online shopping helped small businesses?
opts: It lets them reach customers across the country
It removes the need for products
Items may look different from the photos
Choose sellers with a clear refund policy
